title: settling-cohomology
description: The sheaf cohomology of the settling-associated sheaf: H^0 is the realized global section (a count of designated settled cells) and H^1 is the obstruction to gluing local sections into one global section. It is generated by taking the derived-functor/Cech invariant of the sheaf whose global section a settling produces, and it measures how far a trace is from a coherent fixed point.

h0.description: H^0: the global settled section realized as a count of the designated cells the fixed point reaches

h1.description: H^1: the gluing obstruction; disagreement among local sections that fails to assemble into one global section. H^1 = 0 exactly when the cascade settles (CRDT convergence / cohomological CALM)

vanishesAboveDegreeOne.description: H^n = 0 for all n > 1, so every classification question stays in H^0 and H^1
